label: Employees
description: Employee records, onboarding and employment changes within the organization.

actions.label: Create
actions.description: Add employee records and begin onboarding.

actions.label: Read
actions.description: View the employee list, individual profiles, onboarding queue and employee change history.

actions.label: Update
actions.description: Update employee details, documents, reporting managers and onboarding stages; transfer employees, change employment status and resend invitations. Existing approval rules still apply.

actions.label: Delete
actions.description: Delete employee records where the application permits deletion.

actions.label: Delete

label: HR Approvals

actions.label: Read
actions.description: View HR approval requests and their status.

actions.label: Reject
actions.description: Reject eligible employee change requests, subject to the existing approval rules.

label: Workflows
description: Workflow definitions, forms, requests, tasks, records and execution monitoring.

actions.label: Create
actions.description: Create or duplicate workflow definitions, create workflow records and upload attachments.

actions.label: Read
actions.description: View workflow definitions, forms, requests, tasks, notifications, records, monitoring, bindings and connections; download attachments and export reports. Workflow visibility and field restrictions still apply.

actions.label: Update
actions.description: Update workflow designs, forms and records; configure bindings, connections and membership; test or validate workflows, mark notifications as read, archive definitions and control running instances. Existing workflow policies still apply.

actions.label: Delete
actions.description: Delete workflow definitions that have no executions or protected process bindings.

actions.label: Publish
actions.description: Publish a workflow definition so it can be used, subject to its publisher policy.

actions.label: Start
actions.description: Start a workflow or HR workflow request, subject to its start policy.

actions.label: Act on task
actions.description: Submit an available task decision, such as approval or rejection, only when eligible for that task.
